USAGE:
    Fun.Blazor.Cli.dll generate [PROJECT] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    Fun.Blazor.Cli.dll generate

ARGUMENTS:
    [PROJECT]    Project you want to add bindings

OPTIONS:
                                DEFAULT                                         
    -h, --help                             Prints help information              
    -o, --outDir                           Output directory of generated codes  
    -s, --style                            Dsl style CE                         
        --sdk                              .NET SDK version                     
        --generator-version     4.1.1      Fun.Blazor.Generator version         
        --inline                True       Turn on inline option for generated  
                                           code                                 
        --keep-code-gen-proj               Keep code generation project, it is  
                                           under bin folder of the target       
                                           project
